title: Analysis of a three-dimensional fluid flow in rotating cylinders
summary: Subject of consideration is the modelling and analysis of a capillary-driven three-dimensional rimming-flow problem. We present the derivation of a fourth-order quasilinear degenerate-parabolic partial differential equation for the height $h > 0$ of a fluid film coating the inner wall of a cylinder that rotates around a horizontal axis. The equation arises from a rescaled Navier-Stokes system for thin fluid films by means of a lubrication approximation and accounts for the physical effects of rotation, surface tension and gravity.
